up: Retrieve the first 1000 IC50 activity records (standard_type = 'IC50' with non-null pChEMBL values) for human single-protein target CHEMBL1795188 (Proton-coupled folate transporter). Return assay.chembl_id, target_dictionary.target_type, target_dictionary.tax_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, compound_dictionary.chembl_id, activities.standard_type, activities.pchembl_value. Filter activities where activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL, and the activity belongs to assays targeting CHEMBL1795188 with organism = 'Homo sapiens' (tax_id = 9606). Ensure canonical SMILES is sourced from compound_structures. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return distinct rows for each activity.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id,
         a.assay_id,
         a.molecule_chembl_id,
         a.standard_type,
         a.pchembl_value,
         ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
         t.target_type,
         t.tax_id,
         ds.canonical_smiles
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary t ON ass.tid = t.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_structures ds ON md.molregno = ds.molregno
  WHERE t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795188'
    AND t.tax_id = 9606
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.units = 'nM'
  GROUP BY a.molecule_chembl_id, ass.assay_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
       assay_chembl_id,
       target_type,
       tax_id,
       canonical_smiles,
       molecule_chembl_id,
       standard_type,
       pchembl_value
FROM target_activities
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id;

Ensure the canonical SMILES comes from compound_structures. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Do not add any additional filters beyond those explicitly requested.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id,
         a.assay_id,
         a.molregno,
         a.standard_type,
         a.pchembl_value,
         ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
         td.target_type,
         td.tax_id,
         cs.canonical_smiles,
         md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
  LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795188'
    AND td.tax_id = 9606
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
)
SELECT DISTINCT
       assay_chembl_id,
       target_type,
       tax_id,
       canonical_smiles,
       molecule_chembl_id,
       standard_type,
       pchembl_value
FROM target_activities
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id
